source_observations: The unmodified test starts a three-peer quorum, writes data, restarts, then writes a stale currentEpoch and matching currentEpoch.tmp before another restart (test lines 58-90).

QuorumPeer.loadDataBase reads acceptedEpoch through readLongFromFile; its FileNotFoundException catch assigns acceptedEpoch=epochOfZxid and then reaches the acceptedEpoch<currentEpoch guard (pristine lines 1180-1197).

The exact explicit door is the BufferedReader.readLine call in readLongFromFile (compiled line 2190), configured to throw FileNotFoundException. Prior generic IOException faults escaped to the outer startup catch and showed zero strict same-occurrence continuation; this is a distinct exception subtype/path.

FileNotFoundException on the currentEpoch.tmp read at line1170 is not locally caught; the bounded fault pilot must select the acceptedEpoch read ordinal on the named target occurrence, not assume every call is target retaining.

If the injected acceptedEpoch read uses the fallback epochOfZxid, the selected check can remain reachable. In the existing test that fallback may equal currentEpoch, so this does not by itself predict a target throw.
